title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 11
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q101_halve
elements.title: To ___ a recipe calling for 200 grams of flour, use 100 grams.

elements.name: q102_slim_down
elements.title: He changed his eating habits and began to ___, so his old jacket now feels loose.

elements.name: q103_caught_on_camera
elements.title: The missing food mystery was solved when the cat was ___ opening the cupboard in the security footage.

elements.name: q104_packs_a_punch
elements.title: This small speaker ___: it can fill the whole room with sound.

elements.name: q105_slack_off
elements.title: When the supervisor is away, the team sometimes starts to ___ and stops putting in much effort.

elements.name: q106_blackout
elements.title: A power failure caused a ___, leaving every street in darkness.

elements.name: q107_woefully
elements.title: The venue was ___ unprepared: there was no seating, electricity or running water.

elements.name: q108_rule_out
elements.title: The mechanic tested the battery to ___ a battery fault as the cause.

elements.name: q109_down_to_earth
elements.title: Despite becoming famous, she remained ___ and never acted as if she were more important than others.

elements.name: q110_pay_respects
elements.title: Which expression is most appropriate when describing a visit to a grave to honour the person buried there?
